verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents a way for agents to reach its official docs: its MCP server lets you search the documentation from the development environment. It also offers agent-oriented material in a Claude Code skills plugin and a ready-made prompt library. There is no evidence of an llms.txt file or of agent-formatted docs pages an agent could simply be pointed at by URL. Missing for 10: llms.txt or llms-full.txt, plain agent-readable markdown docs endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Search official Mercado Pago documentation without leaving your development environment.
Claude Code plugin. Skills to help you build complex integrations in minutes.
Prompt library. Ready-made prompts to accelerate your vibe coding.
